title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：proof　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 proof 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the clerk ① offered the proof that no applicant in the office would have recorded, and he said the offering was the whole of the month. The ② proof, meaning the evidence itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; proof, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ sort of proof in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ proof at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Proof, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the clerk said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the proof was the whole of the matter, meaning the truth and not the evidence. The ⑥ proof, meaning the truth and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; proof, he said, is either something you offer or the only word that means both evidence and a truth. He said the truth is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ proof had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ proof of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of recording; proof, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ proof I remember is the proof recorded in the file, which closed in 1975 and is still recorded as the quietest in the office. ⑩ Proof, my mother said in 1977, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all proof, she said, is a truth that has agreed to look like evidence. She said the truth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 证据；证明（指办事处里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 证据；证明（指那份证据本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：offer the proof 拿出这一份证据
D. n. 证据；证明（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 证据之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的证据之事）
F. n. 证据；证明（指卷宗里写到、被记载的那一份）
G. n. 证据、真相（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 真相（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: offered the proof that no applicant in the office would have recorded

the proof at the far counter

answers.why: offer the proof 意为“拿出这一份证据”，1968 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯记载的一份证据做了一遍。
proof 意为“证据；证明”，指那份证据本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。
proof 意为“证据；证明”，指办事处里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
proof 意为“证据；证明”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
proof 意为“证据、真相”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份真相就是那件事的全部。
proof 意为“真相”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份证据，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
proof 意为“证据；证明”，指卷宗里写到、被记载的那一份，到 1973 年这一份成了卷宗里的一行。
proof 意为“证据之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的证据之事是一处办事处和三个月份的记载。
proof 意为“证据；证明”，我记得的是卷宗里记载过的那一份，1975 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一份。
proof 为抽象总称，母亲 1977 年说，证据是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的证据。
